subject.title: [Bug] Compaction-timeout recovery still leaves session assistant-last on 2026.6.11 (regression of #87472 / #88118) — and the continuation throw is scored as model candidate_failed

question: Should this issue be the canonical fix target for the combined compaction-timeout assistant-tail recovery and model-fallback misattribution regression, or should maintainers split the remaining work across the existing timeout, session-poisoning, and compaction-ownership trackers?
rationale: The release already contains the earlier snapshot trim and active-retry fixes, yet the reporter reproduced the same family of failure on v2026.6.11; choosing the owner boundary affects whether the repair changes recovery persistence, fallback classification, timeout policy, or several paths together.

options.title: Keep this as canonical
options.body: Use this issue to drive one combined recovery-state and fallback-classification fix, while preserving linked issues for partial context.

options.title: Split into existing trackers
options.body: Move the timeout-budget part to the existing preflight/aggregate timeout tracker and the poisoned-session part to the existing session-integrity tracker, leaving this issue as evidence only.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers can reproduce the exact v2026.6.11 path with a sanitized large multimodal transcript.

recommendation.title: Keep this as canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue to drive one combined recovery-state and fallback-classification fix, while preserving linked issues for partial context.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both prior compaction fixes directly implicated by the regression claim and is the clearest routing owner for deciding whether those fixes need extension.
